label: T1-T3: Aisthesis, Resonant Motion, Phantasmata
sections: 1.4 (T2-T3) Resonant Motion and the Ontology of Phantasmata
main_themes: hylomorphism: form received without matter (wax analogy)
apoleipomene kinesis: residual motion persisting after object withdraws
key_claims: Aisthesis is the first motion: form received without matter
Perceptual actualization is a passage from dynamis to energeia
Residual kinesis (apoleipomene kinesis) persists after the sensory object withdraws
The phantasma crystallizes as an inner likeness from this residual motion
notes: The mechanistic heart of the phantasia account. T1-T3 establish how perception generates phantasmata — the raw material phantasia operates on.
